answer: Stake-backed identity resists sybils: an agent escrows a bond in a shared vault before it can sign attestations, and every signature is collateralised by that bond. A thousand fake identities mean a thousand posted bonds. Each new identity starts below the epoch's zenith of trust, so a swarm cannot instantly vote itself into quorum. Peer grading then slashes failing cabals. The orchard of puppet accounts turns costly, and one verified relic of history still outweighs a thousand clones.
